extraction.Name: Richard Pierce
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded June 11, 1918, by the First National Bank of Valentine
extraction.Buyer: Pierce and wife conveyed the land by deed to George C. Tobien and J. W. Tobien for $4500
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612692; Southwest quarter of Northwest quarter, the Northeast quarter of Southwest quarter and North half of Southeast quarter section 11, township 35, north of range 27; receipt for patent signed by the allottee February 5, 1918; conveyance to George C. Tobien and J. W. Tobien dated October 17, 1919. Document also contains a separate entry for Varney Clyde Giroux (Fee patent No. 512762, Lots 1 and 2 and east half of Northwest quarter section 7, township 43, range 29; receipt signed February 1918; patent recorded April 16, 1918; mortgaged to Eric A. Brodball for $3307.50 on September 26, 1918, satisfied October 14, 1918; re-mortgaged to Eric A. Brodball for $3307.50 on October 14, 1918, satisfied August 20, 1919; mortgaged to Johnson Farm Loan Company for $1600 on July 21, 1919; sheriff sold the land; on April 18, 1924, sheriff conveyed land by deed to Max M. Katz, assignee of Johnson Farm Loan Company).
